[Open Trade Statistics](https://tradestatistics.io) is an effort to open
international trade data. `tradestatistics` provides an easy way to
obtain data from OTS by accessing its API.

This is what the package does:

![Data diagram](svg/data-diagram.svg)

Data diagram

Using `tradestatistics` package is all about efficiency, without this
package you could obtain the same data from the API at the expense of
using additional time and effort for the same results. As an API wrapper
and utility program this package makes data obtaining faster and easier
for you.

## Installation

``` r

# Install stable version from CRAN
install.packages("tradestatistics")

# Install stable version from GitHub
devtools::install_github("ropensci/tradestatistics")
```

## Code of conduct

Please note that this project is released with a [Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html).
By participating in this project you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ots_commodities`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_commodities.md)
  : OTS Commodities
- [`ots_commodities_short`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_commodities_short.md)
  : OTS Commodities Short
- [`ots_commodity_code()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_commodity_code.md)
  : String matching of official commodity/section names and Harmonized
  System (HS) codes according to the United Nations nomenclature
- [`ots_countries`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_countries.md)
  : OTS Countries
- [`ots_countries_colors`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_countries_colors.md)
  : OTS Countries Colors
- [`ots_country_code()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_country_code.md)
  : String matching of official country names and ISO-3 codes according
  to the United Nations nomenclature
- [`ots_create_tidy_data()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_create_tidy_data.md)
  : Downloads and processes the data from the API to return a
  human-readable tibble
- [`ots_gdp_deflator`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_gdp_deflator.md)
  : GDP Deflator
- [`ots_gdp_deflator_adjustment()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_gdp_deflator_adjustment.md)
  : Expresses tidy data from the API in dollars of a reference year
- [`ots_sections`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_sections.md)
  : OTS Sections
- [`ots_sections_colors`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_sections_colors.md)
  : OTS Sections Colors
- [`ots_tables`](https://docs.ropensci.org/tradestatistics/reference/ots_tables.md)
  : OTS Tables
